claims.claim: Under the package Fourier convention, support of psi in [-R,R] restricts prime-power locations to m*log(p)<2R, equivalently p^m<exp(2R).
The 18 original patches and their 4-by-4 refinement into 288 subpatches cover the target rectangle in the implemented rational-cell and dense-grid audits.
The uniform frontier contains 126 configurations. The first sampled any-geometry center escape is R=10, while the first sampled original-patch uniform 3-by-3 escape is R=14.

claims.claim: The R=16 coarse axis grid produces a false escape: raw alpha rises from 0.985277 at step 0.25 to 1.192293 at step 0.025, whose safe alpha remains above 1.
The joint summary references exactly 12 witness files and no stale witness file remains in the witness directory.
All 12 serialized sparse-measure witnesses remain PSD after each support group is renormalized from its serialized floating weights, and all 12 effective lower bounds exceed 1.
The segmented sieve benchmark at R=10.25 enumerates 41,141,456 primes and 41,144,807 prime-power terms below the strict cutoff 799,902,177.
The floating zero-count profile uses the published Trudgian constants 0.112, 0.278, and 2.510 rather than the smaller arXiv abstract constants.
For this research program, the combined observed dual margins and exponential prime cutoff justify stopping support-only expansion and testing axis-notch dictionary co-design next.
